claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Cefotiam is a cephalosporin antibiotic with no antibacterial target in human cells; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines, with any weak effects attributable to nonspecific physicochemical or GABA-receptor-related activity rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
